newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Union-Invest in Luxembourg-based telecomms fund.
newsitem.headline: Union-Invest in Luxembourg-based telecomms fund.

text.p: German fund management group Union-Investment-Group said on Thursday it launched a Global Communication Fund in Luxembourg aimed at investment in telecommunication, media and dataprocessing stocks.
"We forecast to get in a volume of $100 million within a three to five year period," Nicole Ahnepohl of Union Investment's International Department told Reuters.
She forecast the fund would attract between $30 and 40 million in cash within the first year.

The Union-Investment-Group, which has over 46 billion marks under management for retail and institutional investors, said it launched the fund under the name AMF Communication Fund on November 18. It has so far raised about $5 million.
AMF Communication Fund will invest 50 percent in the U.S., 25 percent in Europe and 25 percent in Asia, based primarily on the Goldman Sachs & Co index on telecommunications stocks.
The fund will be available to investors outside Luxembourg.
